challenges.name: daily-sales-report
challenges.title: Write the daily sales report with collection operations
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh order export logs every status change, so an order delivered in the morning and refunded in the afternoon appears twice. Write summarize so that only the last line of each order counts, revenue includes delivered orders only, stores and categories are ranked by revenue (ties alphabetical), and the top order and average basket are computed from delivered orders, with null when nothing was delivered. Use associateBy, filter, groupBy, groupingBy, sumOf and sortedWith instead of index loops. The test runner reads the export and prints the report.

tests.name: A simple day with one cancelled order
tests.input:
CX-1001 kim-ma meat 245000 delivered
CX-1002 kim-ma vegetables 60000 delivered
CX-1003 cau-giay dairy 120000 delivered
CX-1004 cau-giay meat 185000 cancelled
tests.expected:
orders: 4 (delivered 3, refunded 0, cancelled 1)
revenue: 425000 VND
store kim-ma: 305000 VND
store cau-giay: 120000 VND
category meat: 245000 VND
category dairy: 120000 VND
category vegetables: 60000 VND
top order: CX-1001 kim-ma 245000 VND
average basket: 141666 VND
